conflicts_and_gaps: Bybit documents timing uncertainty around settlement. Local strict transaction cutoff is a new policy, not parity.
Public market APIs do not establish local per-account rounding or a custody-authorized capital source.
Only a trusted existing deposit supplies the synthetic treasury cash boundary; operator authentication and real custody proof remain unimplemented.
No durable scheduler or unsettled-obligation registry exists; failure must be recorded outside this component and cannot be treated as settled.
Existing DecisionAudit numerical replay does not attest new funding eligibility.
No managed fencing capability, code-bound migration, replication, real-money activation or capacity acceptance.

sources.paraphrase: Funding transfers between opposite perpetual positions. Positive rate pays short holders from long holders; negative rate reverses. Linear position value uses quantity and mark. Intervals differ and positions around settlement can have uncertain inclusion.
Funding history is market data; product information supplies intervals. This endpoint alone does not establish an account funding ledger.
Historical records identify the rate, time and associated mark. Regular and Special rate types are distinct; the local prototype implements only vanilla linear funding.
